commitments.detail: Release the toolkit under AGPL-3.0-only and provide corresponding source for the linked AGPL-3.0 core library dependency.
Exclude the sample training corpus entirely from the public release package due to 37 customer support records containing personal data.
Exclude the performance benchmarks package entirely from the public release due to customer-specific results prohibited from public disclosure under enterprise-customer agreements.
Restrict model weight downloads to users in the United States and Canada only, and display an export-control notice on the repository.
